notes:
Lead: Jordan Lee (AE). Mid-market product analytics company building in-app product recommendations and intelligent help. Mid-Jan -> Feb hosted API trial; moving to Dedicated evaluation for predictable latency/cost.

Trial highlights (hosted API):
- Dates: 2026-01-20 to 2026-02-20 (30 days).
- Avg QPS observed: 6 QPS (steady-state); peak observed: 35 QPS during marketing event (2h window).
- Average concurrency (user-facing flows): 3.2 concurrent open sessions; peak concurrency 18.
- Token mix: ~70% chat/completions (avg ~420 tokens per request), 20% embeddings (avg 512 tokens), 10% reranking (avg 250 tokens).
- Avg p95 latency (hosted): 180ms for short-gen flows (<=128 tokens), 520ms for long generations (~400 tokens).
- Monthly token consumption (trial extrapolated): ~1.1B tokens/mo for current feature set.

Requirements / asks from HyperGrove team:
- SLO: p95 generation latency <= 300ms for short responses, p95 <= 700ms for long responses during normal traffic.
- Throughput target for Dedicated: sustained 20 QPS with 3x burst headroom (target bursts to 60-70 QPS).
- Cost sensitivity: wants dedicated unit economics to be <= hosted spend at scale (target blended cost < $0.02 per 1k tokens equivalent).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Quotes / paraphrases: "If Dedicated can get us consistent 200-300ms p95 on chat and predictable pricing, we can expand to other products."

POC asks we committed to: prototype KV-prefix caching for re-used prompts; run stress test simulating marketing event; provide sizing + recommended GPU profile; draft pricing tiers for reserved baseline + burst.

Internal notes: product team cares most about latency and predictable tail behavior. Legal requires SOC2 evidence before procurement commit. Technical folks want SAML attribute map (email -> id) sample before staging.

Next-step action items assigned: send Dedicated sizing doc + price sheet (Jordan/Priya) by 2026-03-17; schedule 1-hour capacity planning workshop (w/ infra + product) for week of 2026-03-22; CSM intro once procurement starts (Miguel).
